ocr_samples: 私のオリジナルと交換してくれよ
よく考えろわたしのは世界に一つしかないレアものだぜ
でもそっちのは世界中に何百万とあるんだぜ
レティに小遣いもらったのだ
アホ!誰がそんなもんいるか!
translations: What do you have with you?
Please exchange it for my original one.
Think carefully, mine is a rare item that exists only once in the world.
But yours exists millions of times around the world.
I got some money from Reti.
Idiot! Who would have thought there would be such things!
